rationale: The long thesis is intact — price holds above the 9-EMA ($42.71) and VWAP ($42.55), sits at 93.6% of the daily range, and continues to show relative strength against a weak SPY — while the last five 1-minute bars are an orderly, low-volume coil just under the high rather than distribution.
